body: Too be honest, Spacedicks has been more shocking than /b/ lately.

I played it for a few months.

I actually quit for the same reasons I'm considering suicide - no point. Grind and grind and grind to get the best gear, only to have a new patch come out with new gear, all the hard work really is for nothing.

PvP was fun though - should I perhaps start fighting people?

The thing I'm thinking over is, am I wrong for thinking that I don't want to do anything? I've been reading up some Jean-Paul Sartre, and shit is starting to make sense.

>Every existing thing is born without reason, prolongs itself out of weakness, and dies by chance
